versions.changelog:
Initial release of the ApplyTop CLI and Node client.

- Search and manage jobs, alerts, matches, saved jobs, and CVs via the command line or Node.js.
- Supports AI-powered CV tailoring, ATS scoring, and cover letter generation (requires Pro account and consumes credits).
- Flexible authentication: per-command flag, environment variable, or saved credentials.
- All commands emit JSON for easy scripting; comprehensive error handling and exit codes.
- Includes programmatic usage examples with exported client methods.
- Detailed usage documentation and workflow guidance included.
